claims.finding: On 2026-09-04, the last session before the print, WDH traded 1,676,400 shares against a 254,685 20-day average and 201,700 the day before - 6.6x average, 8.3x the prior session and by far the heaviest day of the run-in - and closed at $1.02, back above the $1.00 mark after seven consecutive closes below it ($0.994, $0.995, $0.995, $0.993, $0.985, $0.976, $0.973 on 8/25 to 9/2, a two-cent band on 138,800-208,300 shares); nothing in the capture explains it - the last filing of any kind was a 6-K accepted 2026-07-24T20:01:08Z and the only commentary in the window is three StockTwits posts.

claims.why_not_priced: A 20-day realised vol of 13.2% on a $1 Chinese ADS is the signature of a stock being held in place, and the shareholder record says exactly that on 2026-08-10: 'looks almost like the price is being prevented from falling below $1'. A single 1.68m-share session that breaks the pin upward on the eve of the print is either an accumulator or the company's own bid defending the NYSE $1 threshold before releasing results; either way it is one-directional flow that no news, no filing and no aggregator has attached a reason to. If it were priced there would be a filing or a captured item, and there is neither - the news channel returned zero items for this name across all ten sweeps.
claims.independence: One supporting datapoint from a different source, and it is weak: a post of 2026-09-03T11:03:30Z in the same digest says 'Market share rising: GSE market share increased to 15%', which is the only company-specific claim anywhere in the run-in window and which I could not trace to a company release. Nothing else in this corpus points the same way. none.
